name: furrbox
description: FurrBox private Windows 11 inspired desktop environment with real-time file sync.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:4000/health && electron ./electron/main.js"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:4000/health && electron ./electron/main.js"
scripts.build: npm --workspace frontend run build && npm --workspace backend run build
scripts.build:exe-frontend: cross-env NEXT_STATIC_EXPORT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://5.249.162.130:4000 NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_PRESENCE_TOOL=false npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:exe-frontend:standard: cross-env NEXT_STATIC_EXPORT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://5.249.162.130:4000 NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_PRESENCE_TOOL=false npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:exe-frontend:admin: cross-env NEXT_STATIC_EXPORT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://5.249.162.130:4000 NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_PRESENCE_TOOL=true npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.dist:standard: npm run build:exe-frontend:standard && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=Standard node scripts/write-edition.js && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=Standard electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=Standard node scripts/collect-update-artifacts.js
scripts.dist:admin: npm run build:exe-frontend:admin && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=AdminEdition node scripts/write-edition.js && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=AdminEdition electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs && cross-env FURRBOX_EDITION=AdminEdition node scripts/collect-update-artifacts.js
scripts.dist:dual: npm run dist:standard && npm run dist:admin
scripts.lint: npm --workspace frontend run lint && npm --workspace backend run lint
